lines.zh: 我不落地，踏着空气往前走
lines.en: I do not land; I walk on air.

lines.zh: 气在脚下托着，步子很轻
lines.en: Ki holds me up, so my steps are light.

lines.zh: 我从半空掠过，衣角翻卷
lines.en: I glide past midair, my clothes snapping.

lines.zh: 两米二的身形飘着走，很稳
lines.en: Two meters of me drifting steady.

lines.zh: 我一步步逼近，不急
lines.en: I close in one step at a time, unhurried.

lines.zh: 脚尖点向空气，像踩台阶
lines.en: My toes tap the air as if on stairs.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，边走边看空隙
lines.en: I circle you, watching for openings as I go.

lines.zh: 气息压得很低，走路都没声
lines.en: My ki pressed low, my walk makes no sound.

lines.zh: 我飞得比走得多，可今天想走走
lines.en: I fly more than walk, but today I walk.

lines.zh: 悬在半空的脚步，一步一顿
lines.en: Hovering steps, one pause at a time.

lines.zh: 我前进的路线是斜的，从不走直线
lines.en: My approach is always diagonal, never straight.

lines.zh: 身后拖着一道淡淡的气痕
lines.en: A faint ki trail drags behind me.

lines.zh: 我悬在原地，气息收得很紧
lines.en: I hang still, my ki drawn in tight.

lines.zh: 双手垂着，随时能抬起来
lines.en: Hands low, ready to rise at any moment.

lines.zh: 我在算你的气有多强
lines.en: I am reading the level of your ki.

lines.zh: 身体比看上去重，落地会陷
lines.en: I am heavier than I look; I would dent the floor.

lines.zh: 我不说话，只用眼角看你
lines.en: I say nothing, watching from the corner of my eye.

lines.zh: 气在体内转了一圈，又沉下去
lines.en: My ki cycles once and settles again.

lines.zh: 我微微抬下巴，像在衡量
lines.en: I lift my chin slightly, measuring.

lines.zh: 空中的风从我身侧分开
lines.en: The wind parts around me in the air.

lines.zh: 我能看见你下一招的方向
lines.en: I can see where your next move will come from.

lines.zh: 这个姿势我已经站了很久
lines.en: I have held this stance a long while.

lines.zh: 我闭上眼，只靠气感辨位
lines.en: I close my eyes and track you by ki alone.

lines.zh: 气息一涨，又立刻压回去
lines.en: My aura swells once, then is crushed back down.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在地上，人却悬在影子上方
lines.en: My shadow lies on the ground while I float above it.

lines.zh: 我俯视你，身形比你要高出一截
lines.en: I look down at you from a head above.

lines.zh: 你的气很弱，可你的站姿不弱
lines.en: Your ki is weak, but your stance is not.

lines.zh: 我偏头，像在确认什么
lines.en: I tilt my head, as if confirming something.

lines.zh: 我认得这种眼神，是准备打的
lines.en: I know that look; it means a fight.

lines.zh: 你在我下方，这个位置对我有利
lines.en: You are below me, which favors me.

lines.zh: 我把双手垂在身侧，没有握拳
lines.en: My hands hang loose, not clenched.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了半拍，我听见了
lines.en: Your breath skipped half a beat; I heard it.

lines.zh: 我从不小看弱者，弱者最会咬人
lines.en: I never underestimate the weak; they bite hardest.

lines.zh: 我飘近一步，又停住
lines.en: I drift one step closer and stop.

lines.zh: 你在打量我，我也在打量你
lines.en: You are sizing me up; so am I.

lines.zh: 这股气，不像本地人
lines.en: This ki does not belong here.

lines.zh: 我抬手，只是把额前的发拨开
lines.en: I raise a hand only to push my hair aside.

lines.zh: 我不需要武器，你也不需要
lines.en: I need no weapon, and neither do you.

lines.zh: 两米二的高度，你得抬头说话
lines.en: At two meters, you have to look up to talk.

lines.zh: 我看你的脚，看的不是你的眼
lines.en: I watch your feet, not your eyes.

lines.zh: 你退了半步，我记住了
lines.en: You stepped back half a pace; I noted it.

lines.zh: 我嘴角动了一下，不算笑
lines.en: The corner of my mouth moves; it is not a smile.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一段空中的距离
lines.en: An empty stretch of air lies between us.

lines.zh: 我退到空中，重新调整气
lines.en: I retreat into the air and reset my ki.

lines.zh: 这一下打散了我的架势
lines.en: That blow broke my guard apart.

lines.zh: 我咬牙，没有出声
lines.en: I grit my teeth and make no sound.

lines.zh: 身体一晃，我立刻稳住
lines.en: I sway, then steady myself at once.

lines.zh: 我抬手抹掉，看都不看
lines.en: I wipe it away without looking.

lines.zh: 这种疼，我受过更重的
lines.en: I have taken worse than this.

lines.zh: 我的气乱了一瞬，又聚回来
lines.en: My ki scatters for an instant, then gathers.

lines.zh: 我退开两步，重新估你
lines.en: I back two steps and re-measure you.

lines.zh: 别以为这一下就够了
lines.en: Do not think that is enough.

lines.zh: 一颗仙豆，我认得那个形状
lines.en: A senzu bean; I know that shape.

lines.zh: 我伸手，但没有走近
lines.en: I reach out, but do not come closer.

lines.zh: 战斗中吃东西，我不习惯
lines.en: Eating mid-fight is not my habit.

lines.zh: 这东西能补气，我闻得出来
lines.en: That restores ki; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我先看你的手，再看豆子
lines.en: I check your hand first, then the bean.

lines.zh: 肚子确实空了，打久了
lines.en: My stomach is indeed empty after a long fight.

lines.zh: 我接过来，一口吞下
lines.en: I take it and swallow it whole.

lines.zh: 这点食物，不够我恢复
lines.en: That much food will not restore me.

lines.zh: 你递东西的手很稳，这让我放心
lines.en: Your hand is steady; that reassures me.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，气马上回来了
lines.en: One bite, and my ki returns.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，气浪向两边散开
lines.en: We collide, and the shockwave parts sideways.

lines.zh: 我没退，只是身形晃了一下
lines.en: I do not give ground; I only sway.

lines.zh: 身体比看起来沉，你被弹开
lines.en: I am heavier than I look; you bounce off.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我判断出你的力量
lines.en: From that impact I know your strength.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡在身前，硬接下来
lines.en: I raise my arm and take it square.

lines.zh: 衣料被撞得贴在身上
lines.en: My clothes press flat against me.

lines.zh: 我侧身卸掉一半的力
lines.en: I turn my shoulder and shed half the force.

lines.zh: 空中不好借力，我退得远了些
lines.en: Hard to brace in the air, so I give more ground.

lines.zh: 脚下的气散了一瞬
lines.en: My foothold of ki scatters for an instant.

lines.zh: 撞完我们各退一步，重新看对方
lines.en: We both step back and study each other again.

lines.zh: 我们并肩悬着，气连在一起
lines.en: We hang side by side, our ki linked.

lines.zh: 同门的默契，不用说话
lines.en: The understanding of comrades needs no words.

lines.zh: 我们背靠背，各守一个方向
lines.en: Back to back, each guarding a direction.

lines.zh: 你出拳，我补位，节奏合上了
lines.en: You strike, I cover; our rhythm aligns.

lines.zh: 这份信任，是打出来的
lines.en: This trust was forged in fighting.

lines.zh: 我把最弱的一侧交给你
lines.en: I give you my weakest side.

lines.zh: 我们同时收气，同时吐出
lines.en: We draw in ki and release at the same instant.

lines.zh: 远处有人看着，我们没理会
lines.en: Someone watches from afar; we pay no mind.

lines.zh: 气叠在一起时，风都变了向
lines.en: When our ki overlaps, the wind changes.

lines.zh: 我们约好，谁倒下另一个接着打
lines.en: We agree: whoever falls, the other fights on.

lines.zh: 我捏起它，指尖有气在跳
lines.en: I pinch it, ki dancing at my fingertips.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，用不上力
lines.en: Something so small needs no strength.

lines.zh: 我掂了掂，重量不对
lines.en: I weigh it in my hand; the weight is wrong.

lines.zh: 我把它收进怀里，留着
lines.en: I tuck it away for later.

lines.zh: 拿起来时我没低头
lines.en: I do not lower my head to pick it up.

lines.zh: 我用气把它吸到手上
lines.en: I draw it to my hand with ki.

lines.zh: 这个能补气，我留着打
lines.en: This restores ki; I save it for the fight.

lines.zh: 我确认了一遍，才收下
lines.en: I check it once before keeping it.

lines.zh: 手一松，它就飘起来了
lines.en: I let go, and it floats.

lines.zh: 我不贪，拿一件就够
lines.en: I am not greedy; one is enough.

lines.zh: 你抬手的那一刻，我就锁定了
lines.en: The moment you raise your hand, I have you.

lines.zh: 你的气动了，位置暴露了
lines.en: Your ki moved; your position is exposed.

lines.zh: 我看出你下一招会往左
lines.en: I can see your next strike going left.

lines.zh: 距离够我起跳了
lines.en: The distance is enough for me to launch.

lines.zh: 我压低身形，气在脚底聚起
lines.en: I drop low, ki gathering under my feet.

lines.zh: 你不是最强的，但你站得最直
lines.en: Not the strongest, but you stand the straightest.

lines.zh: 我决定了，先拆你的架势
lines.en: Decided: I break your stance first.

lines.zh: 空中的角度我占着
lines.en: I hold the angle from above.

lines.zh: 你还没动，我已经预判了三个方向
lines.en: Before you move I have read three directions.

lines.zh: 目标锁定，气也稳了
lines.en: Target locked, ki steady.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊是浪费气
lines.en: I do not shout; shouting wastes ki.

lines.zh: 我上升半米，正好在你视线外
lines.en: I rise half a meter, just out of your sight.

lines.zh: 这一战我等的就是你
lines.en: This fight is the one I waited for.

lines.zh: 你的重心偏了，机会来了
lines.en: Your weight is off; the chance is here.

lines.zh: 我把双手抬到胸前
lines.en: I bring both hands up before my chest.

lines.zh: 最后一瞬，我停住呼吸
lines.en: At the last instant, I hold my breath.

lines.zh: 我在你上方画圈，一圈比一圈紧
lines.en: I circle above you, each loop tighter.

lines.zh: 你的气一涨，我就退半米
lines.en: When your ki rises, I give half a meter.

lines.zh: 我预判你的闪避，提前换位
lines.en: I read your dodge and move before you.

lines.zh: 你在找我，我一直在你背后
lines.en: You search for me; I am always behind you.

lines.zh: 我不急，你的气会先耗
lines.en: I am patient; your ki will drain first.

lines.zh: 空中连击的角度我算好了
lines.en: I have the angles for an aerial combo.

lines.zh: 你每次抬手，我都提前半拍
lines.en: Each time you raise a hand, I am half a beat early.

lines.zh: 我的气散成薄薄一层，藏住身形
lines.en: My ki thins into a veil that hides me.

lines.zh: 你转身太慢，这是你的弱点
lines.en: You turn too slowly; that is your weakness.

lines.zh: 我在等你的破绽，不是你的失误
lines.en: I wait for an opening, not a mistake.

lines.zh: 你退了，我就不追，等你自己回来
lines.en: You retreat and I do not chase; I wait for you.

lines.zh: 这一圈我贴得很近，你该感觉到了
lines.en: This pass is close; you should feel it.

lines.zh: 气功波在手里聚成形
lines.en: A ki blast takes shape in my palm.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声告诉我你累了
lines.en: Your breathing tells me you are tired.

lines.zh: 我把距离压到最短
lines.en: I close the distance to its minimum.

lines.zh: 你若跳起，我就从上方截住
lines.en: If you jump, I cut you off from above.

lines.zh: 我不只用眼睛，我用气看你
lines.en: I see you with ki, not only eyes.

lines.zh: 最后一步，我落地了
lines.en: One last step, and I touch down.

lines.zh: 一记直拳，气随拳出
lines.en: A straight punch, ki riding the fist.

lines.zh: 我从上方压下，连打三下
lines.en: I drive down from above, three hits in a row.

lines.zh: 肘击转膝撞，节奏不停
lines.en: Elbow into knee, the rhythm unbroken.

lines.zh: 空中连段，你被打得没落地
lines.en: An aerial combo; you never touch the ground.

lines.zh: 掌根推出，气在掌前炸开
lines.en: My palm thrusts, ki bursting before it.

lines.zh: 我踢你的支撑腿
lines.en: I kick out your supporting leg.

lines.zh: 气功波贴着地面推过去
lines.en: A ki blast skims along the ground.

lines.zh: 这一下我用了一半的力
lines.en: That one carried half my strength.

lines.zh: 你挡住了，但我没停
lines.en: You blocked, but I do not stop.

lines.zh: 我转身补一记后踢
lines.en: I spin into a back kick.

lines.zh: 你的架势被拆开了
lines.en: Your stance is broken open.

lines.zh: 我从侧面切入，避开你的正面
lines.en: I cut in from the flank, avoiding your front.

lines.zh: 力道收着，留三分
lines.en: I hold back three parts of the force.

lines.zh: 打完我立刻升空，不留在原地
lines.en: Done, I rise at once, never staying put.

lines.zh: 这一拳是为了试你的硬度
lines.en: That punch was to test how hard you are.

lines.zh: 我的气还没真正放开
lines.en: My ki is not truly released yet.

lines.zh: 半空中先出现一道气，然后是我
lines.en: A ki flare appears in the air, then me.

lines.zh: 我从云层下压下来，落在你面前
lines.en: I drop from beneath the clouds before you.

lines.zh: 任务把我放在这里，我就站在这里
lines.en: A mission set me here, so here I stand.

lines.zh: 这不是自然生成的地方，我知道
lines.en: This is not a natural spawn; I know it.

lines.zh: 两米二的身形浮在半空
lines.en: A two-meter frame hangs in the air.

lines.zh: 我的气先到，人后到
lines.en: My ki arrives before my body.

lines.zh: 空气被我的存在压得发闷
lines.en: The air grows heavy where I appear.

lines.zh: 我扫了一眼四周，记住了退路
lines.en: I scan the area and memorize the exits.

lines.zh: 有人把我叫来了，是谁
lines.en: Someone called me here; who?

lines.zh: 我的衣摆在无风的地方翻动
lines.en: My clothes stir where there is no wind.

lines.zh: 这里的重力，我不太适应
lines.en: This gravity does not sit right with me.

lines.zh: 战斗的预感先来了
lines.en: The premonition of a fight comes first.

lines.zh: 我落地时脚没有陷进土里
lines.en: My feet do not sink when I land.

lines.zh: 这地方太安静，安静得不对
lines.en: Too quiet here, and the wrong kind of quiet.

lines.zh: 我站在结构门口，等里面的人
lines.en: I stand at the doorway of the structure, waiting.

lines.zh: 我的影子从上方落下
lines.en: My shadow falls from above.

lines.zh: 气息一收，四周的鸟全飞了
lines.en: My aura settles, and the birds scatter.

lines.zh: 我来得不快，但我来了
lines.en: I did not come quickly, but I am here.

lines.zh: 火贴着气烧上来，我甩手扑灭
lines.en: Fire climbs my ki and I shake it off.

lines.zh: 我从高处坠下去，撞得骨头闷响
lines.en: I fall from height, bones thudding.

lines.zh: 水压住我的气，我往上挣
lines.en: Water crushes my ki; I struggle upward.

lines.zh: 冲击波把我推出去好远
lines.en: The blast hurls me far back.

lines.zh: 一枚东西打进肩里，我抬手拔掉
lines.en: Something lodges in my shoulder; I pull it out.

lines.zh: 一股怪力缠住我的气
lines.en: A strange force coils around my ki.

lines.zh: 打得忘了吃，气都虚了
lines.en: I forgot to eat and my ki runs thin.

lines.zh: 雷顺着气走遍全身，我抖了一下
lines.en: Lightning runs through my ki; I shudder.

lines.zh: 脚下连空气都没有了
lines.en: There is not even air beneath my feet.
